sources: Google Maps place 'Andersonville RV Park', 213 W Church St (4.3 stars, 91 reviews, phone +1 229-924-2558), read 2026-10-29

values.note: RV nightly rate $35, tent camping $15. 10% senior discount (55+) or 10% military discount, not combined. The page carries no date; it was read live on 2026-10-29 and warns that other websites' prices are not theirs.

fees.source: https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('RV Nightly Rate is $35.00 per night', 'Tent Camping is $15.00 per night', '10% Senior Discount for 55 and older', '10% Military Discount (Discounts can not be used together)'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('Twenty of these sites offer 30/50 amp electric service and water/sewer'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 23 sites in all; the 20 with 30/50-amp electric, water and sewer are counted. 4 pull-throughs and 7 back-ins on concrete pads.

sites.source: https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('The Andersonville RV Park has 23 sites. Twenty of these sites offer 30/50 amp electric service and water/sewer. There are 4 pull-throughs and 7 back-in sites with concrete pads'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Shower house; two community fire pits.

facilities.source: https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('Amenities Include: Shower house ... 2 community fire pits'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Reservations by phone through the Andersonville Welcome Center, 229-924-2558.

booking.source: https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('For More Info or to make a reservation Please call the Andersonville Welcome Center at 229-924-2558'), read 2026-10-29

note: Andersonville RV Park, 1 1/2 blocks from downtown Andersonville and under a mile from Andersonville National Historic Site; wooded setting. --Claude
summary: Read the Andersonville Guild's accommodations page (the only page for the park; the City of Andersonville's own site has no campground page). Set fees $35 (tent $15), military discount, 20 hookup sites (of 23) with 4 pull-throughs, showers, phone booking via the Welcome Center. Changed electric 30 -> 50 (page: '30/50 amp') and site count 25 -> 20. Nightly rate posted, so nights are sold; the page names no weekly/monthly rates, so that note line was dropped. Note cleaned.
flags: Phone: empty in the entry; reservations are taken by the Andersonville Welcome Center at 229-924-2558 (on the Guild page and the park's Google Maps listing).

Website: https://andersonvillegeorgia.info/ is the Andersonville Guild's (historic preservation society) site, not the city's; its page for the park is https://www.andersonvillegeorgia.info/accommodations.html ('Andersonville RV Park'). The City of Andersonville's site (https://cityofandersonville.com/) has no campground page, so I could not confirm from the city that it operates the park; the Guild page says 'We are not responsible for any pricing or information that is put out by any website other than ours.'
Name: published as 'Andersonville RV Park' (Guild page, Google Maps, Explore Georgia), not 'Andersonville City Park Campground'.
Rate date: the Guild's $35 is undated; a Campendium camper reported $32 in June 2025, consistent with $35 being current.
